svg.title: nSPAWN: System1 Task Routing, Quota Walls & Process Custody
svg.desc: Architectural diagram illustrating System1 classification, quota admission, and caged process custody in nSPAWN.

g.text: nSPAWN: System1 Task Routing, Quota Walls & Process Custody
Closed execution taxonomy, fail-safe quota evaluation, and isolated process containment
Routing target: thrift vs design vs frontier capability
Structured primitives replacing ambiguous freeform prompts
cooling_until barrier prevents early account burn
Pool arbitration selects optimal host accounts
Never report 0% for unknown usage; fail closed
Fences key/index in parallel batch runs
Scoped bounds: strictly restricted to cwd + read_paths
Prevents PID recycling collisions & rogue forks
Drains systemd slice before releasing claims
Ensures atomic lock release and complete resource reclamation
Fresh evaluation agent with zero prompt context
Immutable witness frames stored as audit proof
